title: SPCM1-TAGBANK: live-cap-indexed quantum records with linear classical space and exact polynomial envelopes

claims.statement: For every N>=2,s in Z/NZ,n=ceil(log2N), the SAME physical SPCM1-TAGBANK bit-code completion of proof.md executing COMPLETE SPC-M1 P in virtual.md recovers the WHOLE secret unconditionally with probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. All bounds hold jointly on EVERY branch, including wrong labels, failed/recycled pairs, failed merges, rejected/discarded sources, supplier/demand/acquisition aborts, initialization and cleanup. Fully charged time is O(n^120*2^((2649/2000)*sqrt n)), exact growth index1/2. All original streamed NEXT/slot, capped table, source/delivered quota, LE/decoder and stopping laws are retained. Direct known-index basis records use lazy tags with exact finite-overflow repair and an indexed banked quantum free list, never an exponential pool scan per operation. Deterministic flow sum A_i<=2A_0 and disjoint fresh merge inputs yield O(n^4)*(C_P+Qcap+H+1) wire/ownership events. O(n^4) control completion and O(n^100) charged helpers give O(n^108)*(T_P+Qcap+H+1)+O(n^100)*D. Source T_P=O(n^6*2^(bT*sqrt n)),bT=2649/2000; D=O(n^28*2^(bS*sqrt n)),H=O(n^2*2^(bS*sqrt n)),bS=1999/2000. Exact gapbT-bS=13/40 absorbs prefix polynomial above the declared120. Eventually no epoch overflow occurs; every finite earlier overflow is exactly repaired with no new failure/source event, changing only an outside constant.

For every N>=2,s in Z/NZ,n=ceil(log2N), the SAME physical SPCM1-TAGBANK bit-code completion of proof.md executing COMPLETE SPC-M1 P in virtual.md recovers the WHOLE secret unconditionally with probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. All bounds hold jointly on EVERY branch, including wrong labels, failed/recycled pairs, failed merges, rejected/discarded sources, supplier/demand/acquisition aborts, initialization and cleanup. Peak ordinary classical workspace is O(n) bits, exact growth index0. Count input/output, constant-many O(n)-bit staged operands/addresses/current-frame words, finite control and reusable bits/indices. Every large slot/table, numerical/frame/profile/decoder/generator record, quantum free-list/descriptor field and tag value is COUNTED basis storage and streamed. Public parameters are computed in O(n) staging before bank initialization and full profiles banked afterward. Ccap/Dcap quota VALUES are O(n)-bit words, not huge ordinary arrays. Operation/event powers do not denote materialized ordinary scratch. No duplicate classical stack/directory/circuit or growing transcript exists.

For every N>=2,s in Z/NZ,n=ceil(log2N), the SAME physical SPCM1-TAGBANK bit-code completion of proof.md executing COMPLETE SPC-M1 P in virtual.md recovers the WHOLE secret unconditionally with probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. All bounds hold jointly on EVERY branch, including wrong labels, failed/recycled pairs, failed merges, rejected/discarded sources, supplier/demand/acquisition aborts, initialization and cleanup. Peak FULL allocated quantum workspace is O(n^28*2^((1999/2000)*sqrt n)), exact growth index1/2. Set U=2^w+1,w=floor((1999/2000)*ceil(sqrt n)),A=2^16*n^2,R=2^24*n^4*U,Wrow=2^16*n^2,H=2^20*n^2*U. Every actual SLOT/phase/merge array has <=O(2^w) rows, source coherent live slots <=1+ell*2^w plus polynomial scratch, and all H-row quantum metadata fit R because R/H=16n^2. Full B=2^56*n^8*U,e=(n+2)^20,D=B*(e+1)+(A+8)*e+A+2^20*n^4 include all value/tag/raw/header/backup/descriptor/free-list/inactive owner/row/field/pool/padding spans. Whole paired prefix and source temporaries give O(D+H+n). U=O(2^(bS*sqrt n)),bS=1999/2000,so D=O(n^28*2^(bS*sqrt n)). No cumulative Ccap-row memory is introduced. This is maximum-address storage independent of lifetime and outcomes, not occupancy or omitted metadata.

For every N>=2,s in Z/NZ,n=ceil(log2N), the SAME physical SPCM1-TAGBANK bit-code completion of proof.md executing COMPLETE SPC-M1 P in virtual.md recovers the WHOLE secret unconditionally with probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. All bounds hold jointly on EVERY branch, including wrong labels, failed/recycled pairs, failed merges, rejected/discarded sources, supplier/demand/acquisition aborts, initialization and cleanup. All acquired DCP copies number O(n^3*2^((6788/5125)*sqrt n)), exact growth index1/2. Exactly one physical request executes each original request. Literal Qcap=n*Ccap+K,Ccap=2^13*n*3^ell*(3*K*2^m*dl),K=O(sqrt n),dl=O(sqrt n),ell=ceil(161r/500),m=ceil(407r/500),r=ceil(sqrt n) give Qcap=O(n^3*3^ell*2^m). Exact3^41<2^65 proves log2(3)<65/41 and bQ=(161/500)*(65/41)+407/500=6788/5125. Ceilings change only outside constants. Every rejected supplier, recycled/failed pair, merge discard and quota/batch abort remains counted. Zero bank/pool padding, pointer operations, source SWAPs and exact tag repair are charged work/storage, not additional DCP queries.

For every N>=2,s in Z/NZ,n=ceil(log2N), the SAME physical SPCM1-TAGBANK bit-code completion of proof.md executing COMPLETE SPC-M1 P in virtual.md recovers the WHOLE secret unconditionally with probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. All bounds hold jointly on EVERY branch, including wrong labels, failed/recycled pairs, failed merges, rejected/discarded sources, supplier/demand/acquisition aborts, initialization and cleanup. Guaranteed malformed fraction is epsilon(n)=0 under the exact independent-ideal-copy model. Decoding active tags and the injective live-wire descriptor map preserves complete logical CQ states, source/output law, irreversible forgetting, original slot/pair/merge/decoder instruments and exact allocation/free/renumber channels with arbitrary references. Extra helper readouts are marginalized rather than added to inherited held-out-bit conditioning. No positive robustness, adaptive-supplier transfer or impossibility claim is asserted.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
